title: Create Skill India Account
content: Create a Skill India Digital account using your mobile number and verify it with OTP.

title: Mobile OTP Verification
content: Every learner account requires OTP verification before profile creation.

title: Complete Learner Profile
content: Learners should complete their educational, personal and skill profile before applying for programs.

title: Aadhaar e-KYC
content: Complete Aadhaar based e-KYC using the Aadhaar linked mobile number.

title: Browse Courses
content: Learners can search skill courses by sector, location and training provider.

title: Sector Based Course Search
content: Courses are organized under different industry sectors for easier discovery.

title: Training Batch Search
content: Learners can view available training batches, timings and training centre details.

title: Apply to Batch
content: Selecting a batch submits an enrollment request to the respective Training Partner.

title: Application Status
content: Learners can monitor the progress of their enrollment requests from their dashboard.

title: Digital Learning Dashboard
content: The learner dashboard provides course progress, certificates and enrolled programs.

title: Course Attendance
content: Attendance is maintained throughout the training period for eligible programs.

title: Assessments
content: Learners complete assessments based on the respective course and certification guidelines.

title: Digital Certificate
content: Eligible learners receive digital certification after successfully completing the program.

title: Update Personal Details
content: Learners can update profile information through their account settings.

title: Forgot Password
content: Use the password recovery option available on the official login page.

title: Login Issues
content: Users experiencing login issues should verify their registered mobile number before contacting support.

title: Eligible Programs
content: Eligibility varies by course and is displayed within the respective program details.

title: Learning Progress
content: Learners can monitor completed modules and overall course progress through the portal.

title: University Partnership
content: Universities can collaborate with NSDC to deliver industry aligned academic programs.

title: Student Onboarding
content: Institutions register students, verify academic records and provide learning access.

title: Degree Programs
content: NSDC aligned degree programs combine academic learning with industry skill development.

title: Student Verification
content: Institutions verify learner identity and educational documents before enrollment.

title: LMS Access
content: Students receive LMS credentials after successful onboarding.

title: Faculty Dashboard
content: Faculty members can monitor attendance, assessments and learner engagement.

title: Academic Reports
content: Institutions can generate learner performance reports for academic monitoring.

title: Semester Tracking
content: Student progress can be monitored across semesters within the learning platform.

title: Industry Projects
content: Students participate in practical industry projects as part of applied learning.

title: Placement Readiness
content: Programs emphasize employability, portfolios and industry readiness.

title: Training Partner Registration
content: Training Partners manage approved skill programs and learner batches.

title: Create Training Batch
content: Partners create batches with schedules, capacity and location details.

title: Manage Attendance
content: Attendance records are maintained for enrolled learners throughout the course.

title: Learner Enrollment Approval
content: Training Partners review learner applications before confirming enrollment.

title: Assessment Scheduling
content: Partners schedule assessments according to the approved academic calendar.

title: Batch Capacity
content: Each batch has a predefined learner capacity managed by the Training Partner.

title: Trainer Allocation
content: Training Partners assign trainers to batches based on program requirements.

title: Completion Reports
content: Partners generate completion reports after learner assessments are finalized.

title: Employer Services
content: Employers can connect with skilled candidates through NSDC initiatives.

title: Candidate Search
content: Employers can discover skilled talent aligned with workforce requirements.

title: Apprenticeship Programs
content: Industry partners can participate in apprenticeship and workforce development programs.

title: Workforce Upskilling
content: Organizations can support workforce upskilling through structured training initiatives.

title: Industry Collaboration
content: Industry collaboration helps align academic programs with real workforce needs.

title: Job Readiness
content: Skill development programs focus on improving employability and practical workplace skills.

title: Technical Support Portal
content: Use the official NSDC Support portal for verified technical assistance.

title: Contact Customer Support
content: Users can contact official support channels for account specific assistance.

title: Report Technical Issue
content: Technical platform issues should be reported through the official support workflow.

title: Account Recovery
content: Account recovery should always be completed using official verification methods.

title: Security Policy
content: Never share passwords, OTPs or Aadhaar details with the chatbot.

title: Safe Verification
content: Identity verification must occur only through official NSDC systems.

title: Website Navigation
content: The chatbot can guide users through the NSDC website and explain available services.

title: General Help
content: The NSDC AI Assistant provides guidance for learners, institutions, employers and training partners.
